verses.text: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
lines: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name!
Make his doings known among the peoples.

verses.text: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
lines: Sing to him, sing praises to him!
Tell of all his marvelous works.

verses.text: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.
lines: Glory in his holy name.
Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

verses.text: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
lines: Seek Yahweh and his strength.
Seek his face forever more.

verses.text: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
lines: Remember his marvelous works that he has done:
his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

verses.text: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
lines: you offspring of Abraham, his servant,
you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

verses.text: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
lines: He is Yahweh, our God.
His judgments are in all the earth.

verses.text: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
lines: He has remembered his covenant forever,
the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

verses.text: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,
lines: the covenant which he made with Abraham,
his oath to Isaac,

verses.text: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
lines: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute;
to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

verses.text: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”
lines: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan,
the lot of your inheritance,”

verses.text: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.
lines: when they were but a few men in number,
yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

verses.text: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
lines: They went about from nation to nation,
from one kingdom to another people.

verses.text: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
lines: He allowed no one to do them wrong.
Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

verses.text: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
lines: “Don’t touch my anointed ones!
Do my prophets no harm!”

verses.text: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
lines: He called for a famine on the land.
He destroyed the food supplies.

verses.text: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.
lines: He sent a man before them.
Joseph was sold for a slave.

verses.text: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
lines: They bruised his feet with shackles.
His neck was locked in irons,

verses.text: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.
lines: until the time that his word happened,
and Yahweh’s word proved him true.

verses.text: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
lines: The king sent and freed him,
even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

verses.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,
lines: He made him lord of his house,
and ruler of all of his possessions,

verses.text: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
lines: to discipline his princes at his pleasure,
and to teach his elders wisdom.

verses.text: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.
lines: Israel also came into Egypt.
Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

verses.text: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
lines: He increased his people greatly,
and made them stronger than their adversaries.

verses.text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.
lines: He turned their heart to hate his people,
to conspire against his servants.

verses.text: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
lines: He sent Moses, his servant,
and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

verses.text: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
lines: They performed miracles among them,
and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
lines: He sent darkness, and made it dark.
They didn’t rebel against his words.

verses.text: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.
lines: He turned their waters into blood,
and killed their fish.

verses.text: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
lines: Their land swarmed with frogs,
even in the rooms of their kings.

verses.text: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
lines: He spoke, and swarms of flies came,
and lice in all their borders.

verses.text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
lines: He gave them hail for rain,
with lightning in their land.

verses.text: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
lines: He struck their vines and also their fig trees,
and shattered the trees of their country.

verses.text: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number,
lines: He spoke, and the locusts came
with the grasshoppers, without number,

verses.text: ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
lines: ate up every plant in their land,
and ate up the fruit of their ground.

verses.text: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
lines: He struck also all the firstborn in their land,
the first fruits of all their manhood.

verses.text: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.
lines: He brought them out with silver and gold.
There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

verses.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
lines: Egypt was glad when they departed,
for the fear of them had fallen on them.

verses.text: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.
lines: He spread a cloud for a covering,
fire to give light in the night.

verses.text: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
lines: They asked, and he brought quails,
and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

verses.text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.
lines: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out.
They ran as a river in the dry places.

verses.text: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
lines: For he remembered his holy word,
and Abraham, his servant.

verses.text: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.
lines: He brought his people out with joy,
his chosen with singing.

verses.text: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
lines: He gave them the lands of the nations.
They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

verses.text: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
lines: that they might keep his statutes,
and observe his laws.
Praise Yah!
